result.rationale: Verified in the diff: Admin::EmbeddingController#update only calls render_serialized(@embedding, ...) with no attribute assignment or save — it is a literal no-op that reports success while changing nothing. The frontend saveChanges action calls this.get('embedding').update({}) (even passing an empty payload), and embedding.hbs contains no other save control, so the PUT path is effectively dead/misleading. The endpoint accepts requests and silently discards data, which is a real correctness concern introduced by this diff, not a style nit.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders `@embedding` without persisting anything (`app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`), and the Ember controller defines a `saveChanges` action calling `embedding.update({})` (`admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6`). However, `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` provides no button/control wired to `saveChanges` (only `addHost` and per-host save/delete via `EmbeddableHostsController`). This makes the PUT route/action effectively dead code in this PR, but it doesn't demonstrably break host CRUD (which uses `/admin/embeddable_hosts`).
